digest.component_or_area: plan review rubric T11 (POST-ROLLBACK SCHEMA STATE)
propositions: The T11 post-rollback paragraph generates 8/21 stock findings that are tautologies against append-only stores, obscuring rare real catches like data-loss bugs.

Post-rollback findings must be raised only when a plan (a) changes interpretation of existing records, (b) rewrites/migrates records in-place, (c) removes/narrows a read path, or (d) performs one-way transformation with no back-out.

Purely additive, backward-compatible persistence changes (new record/event types, optional fields, new tables/columns with defaults) must not trigger post-rollback findings as residual data after rollback is the norm in such systems.
The applicability rule must be technology-agnostic (no named store technology) to apply equally to SQL migrations, event stores, document databases, and config formats.
